|personas=* [[General Veers (persona)|Veers]]
|lore=General Maximilian Veers is the model of an Imperial Army officer. Cunning, loyal and a ruthlessly efficient '''leader'''. In charge of the ground assault troops in Vader’s forces.
|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots (4 if Blizzard 1). While piloting an AT-AT, draws two battle destiny if unable to otherwise. While piloting a combat vehicle, its immunity to attrition is +2.
|printings={{Card versions/General Veers (Hoth)}}
|notes=The remastered Players Committee slip for General Veers gives official text dated 4 December 2006. See [[General Veers (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth) (Original)|Original]] for the earlier wording. Both editions keep Veers’s 3 pilot bonus and 4 on Blizzard 1, two battle destiny when otherwise unable while piloting an AT-AT, and +2 attrition immunity for the piloted combat vehicle.
